$comment: Lane parity for the CI guard files (scripts/lane-parity-check.mjs, #2170). Each file in 'files' must be byte-identical on every lane in 'lanes', or the difference must be recorded in 'divergences' with both blob ids and a reason. An entry explains one pair of contents only: when either side changes it goes out of date and the check is red until the change is ported or recorded again. A guard file is one that gates a release (the published-bytes freeze guard), pins the CI toolchain (bun-version-pins), or certifies other guards (the mutation-prover lane).

divergences.reason: v2-only CI change: a new push to a pull request cancels that PR's superseded run of this workflow (a concurrency block). The freeze-guard logic itself matches main.

integration/v2 has main's merged-in-marker and ancestor-tag 'released' fixes (ported from main); integration/v1.3 does not. Whether the 1.3 line needs them is for that line's maintainer; the freeze guard is line-scoped, so it does not affect v2. It also differs as before: the line-scoped port and the shared ls-tree-then-show pin reader on v1.3.

Registry of each lane's own setup-bun steps: v2 registers its v2-only kind lanes (rollback, Z7 identity), and main has its cache-handler-on-every-Next-minor step; the lists differ by design. main's cache-handler-on-every-Next-minor step is on v2 too (next-minor-matrix.yml, with wider triggers), so nothing is left to port. v2 runs one leg (16.4) by design: its peer range admits 16.4 only, and its handler has no 16.3 seed to prove. v2 also registers the self-contained reference-image supply-chain job's setup-bun step (S7-7); main ships no self-contained image job.
